The tool list matches SKILL.md exactly — the acquisition tools (`load_demo_sequence`, `fetch_ensembl_sequence`, `fetch_region`, `fetch_gene_for_expression`, `store_inline_sequence`), the six predict tools (`predict_promoter/splice/enhancer/chromatin/expression` + `find_genes` for annotation), the composite (`find_genes_and_predict_expression`), and `get_job`/`list_jobs`/`list_models`.

I loaded the `genomic-intelligence` skill and, following its SKILL.md, took one small step: since no `GI_API_KEY` is set (so the REST path we cannot use), I connected to the skill's recommended **keyless** hosted MCP demo at `mcp.genomicintelligence.ai/mcp`, completed the Streamable HTTP handshake, and confirmed the server exposes exactly the acquisition/predict/composite tool set that SKILL.md documents — proving the keyless path is live and following it.

VERDICT: DONE — I loaded the skill and followed it by connecting keyless to the hosted Genomic Intelligence MCP demo and verifying its tool set matches SKILL.md.
